segments.text: You hear a dietician talking with a patient.
Okay, Mr. Weiss, so it looks like you haven't lost any weight this month.
Do you have any idea why that might be?
Oh, really?
I feel like I've been trying really hard to lose weight.
In fact, I thought I would take it a step further in the past couple of weeks because
I was a bit bad in the first week or so.
So recently I've been trying to cut out all carbs
and any junk food, you know, to be completely honest though.
I've wound up cheating on my diet.
What you need to stop being so strict with yourself.
We designed your diet so that it would be achievable
when you try and do things too quickly
and make too many changes to what your body is used to.
It's difficult to maintain long-term
and you end up overeating as a result.
Also, I can't imagine that it made you feel good about your progress when you kept going off track?
No, it really didn't.
I see what you're saying.
I guess I need to be kinder to myself and be more patient with the slow and steady route.
